 We are seeking a highly analytical and forward\-thinking Talent Analytics professional to lead the firm's Talent Intelligence and Workforce Analytics agenda. The role will be responsible for building a best\-in\-class people intelligence capability by integrating talent data, market intelligence, advanced analytics, AI, business intelligence, and workforce planning into a unified decision\-support ecosystem.
